mechanics.claim: The target and surrounding enemies are marked with Flux; Ryze's basic abilities against Flux targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.
mechanics.quote: The target and surrounding enemies are also marked with ''Flux'' for 4 seconds. '''Ryze's''' basic abilities against ''Flux'' targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.

mechanics.claim: Casting Spell Flux again on a target reapplies a new Flux debuff and also triggers the previous one, effectively refreshing the duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Spell Flux's'' second cast on a target will apply a new ''Flux'' debuff as well as triggering the previous one (effectively refreshing the duration).

mechanics.claim: The initial missile can be blocked by projectile-intercepting effects, while the spreading bounce missiles cannot.
mechanics.quote: The {{tt|"main"|initial cast}} missile of ''Spell Flux'' is blocked by {{tip|projectile|projectile-intercepting}} effects, while the spreading bounce missiles are not.

mechanics.claim: Spell Flux can be blocked by spell shields.
